description: Assembly source code implementing cryptographic functions for ARM architecture, specifically for BoringSSL's GCM and GHASH operations optimized with NEON instructions.

methods.name: _gcm_init_neon
methods.description: Initializes NEON registers for GCM encryption, loading H and preparing twisted H.

methods.name: _gcm_gmult_neon
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication using NEON instructions.

methods.name: _gcm_ghash_neon
methods.description: Computes GHASH using NEON instructions for ARM architecture.
